effectgroup.name: OuzFX AFX_Move_Elastic_Zoom_Out
effectgroup.description: Mirror of 'Anim · Elastic Zoom-In': wobbles, then snaps down to 40% and vanishes (20 frames, elastic ease-in). Razor 20 frames before the end of the clip and drop it on that last piece – the layer is gone on the last frame (anything after stays hidden).
